author: KASP
photoContext: Confirmed real photograph, dated 1 September 2017: Lithuanian soldier in woodland aiming black FN SCAR-H with scope and bipod. Commons categorizes People with FN SCAR-H and Lithuanian service. The rifle is visible from muzzle through receiver; rear buttstock and part of magazine obscured by the soldier. Visually inspected. This replaces the uncertain manufacturer product render.
